key.text: A two-minute video interview with a professor for a class project. I need a camera, a microphone and a quiet place to film.

output.summary: A two-minute video interview with a professor using a camera and a microphone.

needs.why: To capture clear sound for the interview

ways_considered.process: Borrow a video camera and wireless microphones and film in a quiet spot
ways_considered.reason: Has both a video camera and wireless microphones available to borrow.
Does not provide video production equipment.

ways_considered.process: Record in the podcast or production studio
ways_considered.reason: Has a podcast and production studio suited for recording video and audio.
No specific equipment listed for this request.
Does not offer cameras or microphones.
Scene shop builds theatre sets, not for recording video interviews.

routes.process: Record the interview in the podcast studio
routes.fit_reason: This space provides a quiet room with built-in cameras and microphones for recording. It is ideal for a beginner needing an all-in-one setup.

steps.title: Prepare the plan
steps.detail: Write down your interview questions and check what time you want to record.

steps.title: Reserve the studio
steps.detail: Contact the staff to book the podcast studio.

steps.title: Record the interview
steps.detail: Show up with your professor and use the studio equipment to record your video.

warnings.issue: The podcast studio seats only 4 people.
warnings.fix: Keep your crew and guests to four people or fewer.

routes.process: Check out a video camera and microphones to film the interview
routes.fit_reason: You can borrow the exact camera and microphones needed and film in any quiet location. This lets you choose your own filming spot.

steps.title: Prepare your plan
steps.detail: List your interview questions and plan a quiet place to film.

steps.title: Contact staff
steps.detail: Email the staff to arrange equipment checkout.

steps.title: Collect and film
steps.detail: Pick up the camera and microphones, record your interview, and return the gear.

warnings.issue: Background noise can ruin interview audio.
warnings.fix: Choose a very quiet room away from traffic and air conditioners.
